title.narrative: Support to Employment Creation in Mongolia (SECIM)

description.narrative: Agriculture and Rural Development as major sectors in Mongolia are offering opportunities and development potentials. Taking into account that many people working in agriculture are members of poor households, the relationship between job creation, employment, private sector development and trade is pivotal for the diversification of Mongolia's economy. The project SECIM aims to contribute to an inclusive economic growth and to support alleviation of income inequality in Mongolia. Therefore diversification of the economy while ensuring competitiveness and sustainable economic and employment growth, thus increasing employment opportunities and reducing currently growing social and regional imbalances will be supported. In order to reach the target, specific value chains in Mongolia with a focus on enhanced value added and employment prospects in livestock and vegetable sectors in sub-urban and rural areas of Mongolia will be strengthened.
